thread:
maria: quick ping — opened an urgent docs PR to patch wording and add a status link after last night's outage: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620. Need two approvals, CI preview, then backport.

tony: taking a look now. which pages changed?

maria: serving/rate-limits.md, sdk/python/retries.md, and a new note in /known-issues/outages-2026-03.md. Also updated a tiny SDK snippet to avoid showing raw API keys.

leah: I see the snippet, looks sanitized. One nit: the Dedicated customer wording should mention tenant-specific limits.

maria: good catch, updating that line. re-triggering preview.

docs-ci: preview build queued #2487

docs-ci: preview build failed #2487 — link check error: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-742 returned 502

infra-bot: status page is experiencing degraded responses; engineers investigating.

tony: the link checker will keep failing while the status page is flakey. For this hotfix can we skip the single link check?

maria: I don't want to rewrite the content just to satisfy CI. I'll add an allowlist entry in .docsci/ignored-links.txt and note it in the PR description.

leah: add a short PR note so reviewers know why it's allowed. Also good to add a changelog line.

maria: added allowlist entry and PR note. re-running preview.

docs-ci: preview build succeeded #2488 — preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4620

tony: LGTM on content after the dedicated wording tweak. Approving.

leah: Approved.

maria: Ops has a scheduled maintenance window until 10:30 UTC. This is docs-only but ops asked whether we can delay live deploy. SRE-oncall?

sre-oncall: SRE here — if it's strictly docs text (no config change) we can waive the window and fast-track the deploy. We'll monitor token bucket metrics for 15m after.

maria: merging and kicking off backport to live-docs.

docs-ci: PR merged by maria — running backport job #97

docs-ci: backport succeeded — branch live-docs

infra-bot: starting live deploy job 1104 — monitoring 429/500/502

sre-oncall: watching. If we see uptick in 429s or cache misses we will revert.

infra-bot: live deploy succeeded — job 1104 — docs now live at https://docs.redwood.ai/known-issues/outages-2026-03

tony: verified page loads and SDK snippet sanitization. Status link resolves when status page responds.

leah: added changelog entry under /changelog/2026-03-21.md and a tiny note in the incident thread linking the docs.

maria: opened follow-up issue to add a CI resiliency check (retry linkcheck + status fallback) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/115. Thanks all.

sre-oncall: monitoring cleared after 15m, no regressions observed. closing watch. :white_check_mark:
